second value &lt;45. Reaches CKD 4 after 2022.</div><div style="margin-bottom:6px;"><b>Patient 2:</b>&nbsp;Registers with prevalent CKD 3b so not in CKD 3b cohort. Enters CKD 4 when second value &lt;30.</div><div style="margin-bottom:6px;"><b>Patient 3:</b> Enters CKD 3a when second value &lt;60, and CKD 3b when second value &lt;45. Deregistration terminates both.</div><div style="margin-bottom:6px;"><b>Patient 4:</b> Enters CKD 3a when second value &lt;60. Skips CKD 3b and enters CKD 4 (even though eGFR 12, this is when CKD 4 is confirmed) and CKD 5 before KRT starts</div><div style="margin-bottom:6px;"><b>Patient 5:</b>&nbsp;Only enters CKD 3a once two consecutive values &lt;60. Follow up ends due to death.</div><div><b>Patient 6: </b>Enters CKD 3a but then deregisters. ol.li: Enter each cohort when 2x eGFRs below the upper limit of that stage, at least 90 days apart with not eGFR at or above the upper limit of that stage in between them
Entry only in study window, with 1+ year of registration
Need a recorded earlier eGFR above the stage in that registration period (to know incident)
Follow up is 4 years unless earlier kidney replacement therapy (KRT), death or deregistration

div.div: Patient 1: Enters CKD 3a when second value <60, and CKD 3b when second value <45. Reaches CKD 4 after 2022.
Patient 2: Registers with prevalent CKD 3b so not in CKD 3b cohort. Enters CKD 4 when second value <30.
Patient 3: Enters CKD 3a when second value <60, and CKD 3b when second value <45. Deregistration terminates both.
Patient 4: Enters CKD 3a when second value <60. Skips CKD 3b and enters CKD 4 (even though eGFR 12, this is when CKD 4 is confirmed) and CKD 5 before KRT starts
Patient 5: Only enters CKD 3a once two consecutive values <60. Follow up ends due to death.
Patient 6: Enters CKD 3a but then deregisters. Incident CKD 3b whilst unregistered so only joins CKD 4 and 5 cohorts before starting KRT.
